mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) with UNRATE below 4.5% indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases with UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing expansion regime (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), a concurrent increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates robust consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 106.0), a concurrent decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals deepening economic contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 106.0 and GDPC1 declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
